explanation: Created input.dat for EXCLURAD eta point run with W=1.7, Q2=1.0, cos(theta_cm)=0, phi_cm=90, and vcut=-0.1. The vcut=-0.1 value means the kinematic cut is disabled (condition cutv.gt.1d-12 is false), so the computed vmax is used unmodified. All other parameters use reasonable defaults: lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (proton target), iphy=1 (AO model), ll=1, bmom=2.0, tmom=0.0.
